correctness.rationale: The geometric-smoothness test is exact: Euler identity for binary degree 3 implies F lies in its partial-derivative ideal; absence of projective common zeros of three quadratics is equivalent to height-3 complete intersection and surjectivity (S2)^3 -> S4, 15 rows, verified by bit-linear rank. Independently enumerated all 1023 nonzero ternary binary cubic masks and found 336 geometrically smooth. Canonical XOR triple enumeration gives 5544 distinct all-smooth binary pencils; extending by h outside a given pencil requires h,h+F,h+G,h+F+G smooth, with exactly four valid h per containing net, yielding extension histogram 1680,1848,1848,168 for e=0,1,2,3 and total 6048/7=864 nets. Independently computed rational base-point incidences and obtained all 12 nonzero joint cells exactly as stated. Constructed action of 168 invertible 3x3 F2 matrices on the 10 cubics, obtaining 37 pencil orbits and stabilizer distribution 31,1,3,2 at orders 1,2,3,4. This is a finite complete enumeration certified by the exact regular-sequence smoothness equivalence, not untested geometric point sampling.
